16/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose and scope of tracking within XR systems.

16/S1.subgoal: Compare the critical requirements and uses of tracking in VR versus AR.

16/S2.subgoal: Identify the three main categories of tracking based on what is being tracked.

16/S3.subgoal: Describe how tracking the user's sense organs contributes to the VR experience.

16/S4.subgoal: Explain the methods and limitations of tracking other body parts in virtual environments.

16/S5.subgoal: Describe the importance and applications of tracking the surrounding environment in XR.

16/S6.subgoal: Summarize the categorization of tracking by the target (user, body parts, environment).

16/S7.subgoal: Compare and contrast inside-out and outside-in tracking technologies.

16/S8.subgoal: Explain the operational differences and constraints between inside-out and outside-in tracking.

16/S9.subgoal: Outline the four fundamental steps involved in the tracking data processing workflow.

16/S10.subgoal: Describe the goals and necessity of calibration and registration in a tracking system.

16/S11.subgoal: Explain how sensory data is integrated and how tracking drift is corrected.

16/S12.subgoal: Summarize the key concepts related to what and how tracking operates.

16/S13.subgoal: Review the technological aspects and processes discussed in the lecture before moving to the next topic.
